scope_statement: Image trace preview, calibration, mapping, unequal-grid composition, and Touchstone generation.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: A near-0 dB transmission can fail export when unused ports are intended to be ideally matched.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: JAE RF plus Rosenberger end-to-end generation
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The old -80 dB fallback was nonzero and could push a unity transmission above the sampled passivity limit.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Linear image calibration rejects both explicit 0GHz and unitless 0/5/0.1.
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The image form reused strict-positive, unitless-Hz parsing despite downstream DC support.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: A visible Wilder trace loses its prefix and begins near the middle of the plot.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user rerun of Wilder 910-0077-000 Rev E Figures 33 and 36
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: Steep notch transitions fragmented one hue and the fallback retained only its longest continuity segment.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: Wilder Figure 36 Trace 4 spans the plot but repeatedly jumps between the blue insertion-loss and blue-grey return-loss paths.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user visual review of the real GUI overlay
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The broad hue fallback treated many discontinuities as acceptance evidence and took a per-column median across two physical blue-family identities.

escaped_defects.user_symptom: The repaired Wilder Figure 36 Trace 4 still borrows the other blue-family path at isolated columns, and same-colour plot annotation can replace a short curve segment.
escaped_defects.discovered_via: user second visual review of the real GUI overlay
escaped_defects.failure_mechanism: The tracker had no explicit missing-observation state for a short shared run and the old global p95 screen ignored sparse large errors; the hue fallback also accepted short upward annotation excursions.
